note: Adapted from the species-level description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English, with soldier and worker described and the alate recorded as unknown. Distribution records, synonymic citations and figure numbers are not included.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head capsule moderately elongate and oval, distinctly constricted behind the antennae, antennae 12-segmented, mandibles vestigial with prominent long spine-like processes, pronotum weakly saddle-shaped, 0.34 mm wide; worker antennae 15-segmented, head width 0.99–1.01 mm, pronotum strongly saddle-shaped with a very large anterior lobe.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule brownish yellow, rostrum slightly brownish; abdominal tergites brown, anteriorly somewhat yellow; sternites paler. Head bare, with only a few pairs of hairs; abdominal tergites with very fine microsetae; sternites generally pilose and with a distinct row of hairs. Body length 2.5–3.0 mm. Head moderately elongate and oval, distinctly constricted behind the antennae; length with rostrum 1.26–1.41 mm, length without rostrum 0.67 mm, head width 0.53–0.60 mm; in lateral view concave, with a gentle elevation between. Rostrum narrow and cylindrical, about 2/3 of the head length, 0.47 mm long; in lateral view straight, raised anteriorly. Antennae 12-segmented, segment 3 one and a half times as long as segment 2, segment 4 shorter than segment 2. Mandibles vestigial, with a prominent long spine-like process. Pronotum weakly saddle-shaped, anterior lobe small; anterior margin almost without a notch; 0.34 mm wide.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head yellow, the rest coloured as in the soldier; clypeal margins brown. Head sparsely pilose; abdominal tergites moderately pilose, hair scars weak posteriorly; sternites pilose as in the soldier. Body length 4.0 mm. Head broad and oval, widest at the antennae, frons gently raised; length of head to the apex of the labrum 1.29 mm, head width 0.99–1.01 mm; coronal suture almost indistinct. Fontanelle plate weak, triangular. Antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 half as long as segment 2, segment 4 longer than segment 3, segment 5 subequal to segment 4. Postclypeus large and raised. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, anterior lobe very large, anterior margin without a notch; 0.46 mm wide.
